HSS100P.T Wellness and Life Styles (not for Physical & Occupational Therapy)
HSS100P.T (Wellness and Life Styles (not for Physical & Occupational Therapy)) is a course of 3 credit hours in the University Elective Requirements of the JUST B.Sc. Computer Information Systems (CIS) study plan (plan no. 766).
It is an elective course in the plan and it is taught as an electronic (online) course.
HSS100P.T has no prerequisite.
P.T100 (Wellness and Life Styles (not for Physical & Occupational Therapy)) is listed as equivalent to HSS100P.T.

HSS137 Human Rights
HSS137 (Human Rights) is a course of 3 credit hours in the University Elective Requirements of the JUST B.Sc. Computer Information Systems (CIS) study plan (plan no. 766).
It is an elective course in the plan and it is taught as an electronic (online) course.
HSS137 has no prerequisite.

HSS214VM Animal Products and Public Health(for Non Veterinary Students)
HSS214VM (Animal Products and Public Health(for Non Veterinary Students)) is a course of 3 credit hours in the University Elective Requirements of the JUST B.Sc. Computer Information Systems (CIS) study plan (plan no. 766).
It is an elective course in the plan and it is taught as an electronic (online) course.
HSS214VM has no prerequisite.
VM214 (Animal Products and Public Health(for Non Veterinary Students)) is listed as equivalent to HSS214VM.

CIs201 Introduction to Web Design
CIs201 (Introduction to Web Design) is a course of 1 credit hour in the Department Compulsory Requirements of the JUST B.Sc. Computer Information Systems (CIS) study plan (plan no. 766).
It is a compulsory course in the plan and it is taught on campus.
Before taking CIs201, students must have studied HSS112SE (Introduction to Object- Oriented Programming).
HI201 (Web Design Lab) is listed as equivalent to CIs201.

CIs322 Data Warehousing and Big Data
CIs322 (Data Warehousing and Big Data) is a course of 3 credit hours in the Department Compulsory Requirements of the JUST B.Sc. Computer Information Systems (CIS) study plan (plan no. 766).
It is a compulsory course in the plan and it is taught in blended mode.
Before taking CIs322, students must have studied HSS221CIS (Fundamentals of Database Systems).
DS321 (Big Data) is listed as equivalent to CIs322.

CIs341 Web Applications Development
CIs341 (Web Applications Development) is a course of 3 credit hours in the Department Compulsory Requirements of the JUST B.Sc. Computer Information Systems (CIS) study plan (plan no. 766).
It is a compulsory course in the plan and it is taught on campus.
Before taking CIs341, students must have studied CIs201 (Introduction to Web Design).
DS410 (Internet Programming) is listed as equivalent to CIs341.

CIs431 Decision Support Systems and Intelligent Systems
CIs431 (Decision Support Systems and Intelligent Systems) is a course of 3 credit hours in the Department Compulsory Requirements of the JUST B.Sc. Computer Information Systems (CIS) study plan (plan no. 766).
It is a compulsory course in the plan and it is taught on campus.
Before taking CIs431, students must have studied CIs321 (Data Mining).
HI341 (Information Security and Networks Technology and Policies) is listed as equivalent to CIs431.

CIs435 Information Retrieval
CIs435 (Information Retrieval) is a course of 3 credit hours in the Department Compulsory Requirements of the JUST B.Sc. Computer Information Systems (CIS) study plan (plan no. 766).
It is a compulsory course in the plan and it is taught on campus.
Before taking CIs435, students must have studied Data Structures (HSS211CS or CS211).
DS451 (Information Retrieval) is listed as equivalent to CIs435.

CIs471 Financial Accountng Analysis
CIs471 (Financial Accountng Analysis) is a course of 3 credit hours in the Department Compulsory Requirements of the JUST B.Sc. Computer Information Systems (CIS) study plan (plan no. 766).
It is a compulsory course in the plan and it is taught on campus.
Before taking CIs471, students must have studied CIs321 (Data Mining).

CIs492 Graduation Project 2
CIs492 (Graduation Project 2) is a course of 2 credit hours in the Department Compulsory Requirements of the JUST B.Sc. Computer Information Systems (CIS) study plan (plan no. 766).
It is a compulsory course in the plan and it is taught in blended mode.
Before taking CIs492, students must have studied CIs491 (Graduation Project 1).

CIs413 Advanced Mobile Application Development
CIs413 (Advanced Mobile Application Development) is a course of 3 credit hours in the Department Elective Requirements of the JUST B.Sc. Computer Information Systems (CIS) study plan (plan no. 766).
It is an elective course in the plan and it is taught on campus.
Before taking CIs413, students must have studied CIs381 (Mobile Application Development).

The University Compulsory Requirements of the JUST B.Sc. Computer Information Systems (CIS) study plan (plan no. 766) total 16 credit hours. Students must take all of these courses:
ARB102 Communication Skills in Arabic (3 credit hours)
HSS110 Leader and Social Responsibility (3 credit hours)
HSS119 Entrepreneurship and Innovation (2 credit hours)
MS100 Military Sciences (3 credit hours)
LG101 Communication Skills in English (3 credit hours)
LG103 Life Skills (2 credit hours)
